name: Amoonguss

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Look at a random card from your opponent’s hand and shuffle it into their deck.

flavor:
Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases.
Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss’s caps will
grow out of anywhere the spores touch.
